exec_start.description: Path to the systemd-oomd executable. Override only if using a custom build.

environment_file.description: Path to an optional environment file to load before starting systemd-oomd.

memory_max.description: Hard memory limit for the oomd daemon itself (e.g., '512M'). Leave empty to use systemd defaults.

memory_high.description: Soft memory limit (high watermark) for oomd daemon (e.g., '256M'). Leave empty to use systemd defaults.

cpu_quota.description: CPU quota for oomd (e.g., '10%'). Leave empty to use systemd defaults.

cpu_shares.description: CPU weight (shares) for oomd (e.g., '1024'). Leave empty to use systemd defaults.
